name: diversity-p2c
description: The user's regime at ply 2: coverage from STRONGER foreign play under the Elo window (analyst 6.57; the go-ahead for frozen foreign references: the user 11-12 ~01:05, 'continue the research with the analyst's suggestions'). diversity-p2 (references error-routing-p1's v314 finals, ply-1-trained) was passed by its lines at ~cycle 8 and then trained them on 200-Elo-weaker foreign play for ~390 cycles (its equal-positions read: F-P -2/6, tree -59/-48 against probit-late-p2 at ply 2). Here the four frozen references are base-probit-p2's v599 finals, the strongest ply-2 players on disk (F-P x2 and T-P-Nc-merge fresh-gate cluster trees x2; their architecture is immaterial), which the lines are not expected to pass, under reference_window margin 30 (scope (a): a line trains on a game with a frozen reference only while every reference in it is rated at or above its current version's Elo minus 30; line-line games and self-games always train; ref-ref games train while both pass). The window should stay inert all run; every cut is logged. Lines as diversity-p2: F-P x2, T-P-Ne (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03) x2, seed 48, ply-2 field, self-games (lines only), games_per_cycle 1584 (12 entries: 12 rounds), floor 300, cap 400; hybrid16 games, hybrid6 training. Comparators: base-probit-p2's F-P at equal versions (equal batch; the factor is stronger foreign games in place of sibling games), probit-late-p2 at equal versions, diversity-p2 (same lines and seed: reference strength in practice). Reads: per-ply arenas at plies 1 and 2 (no ply 3): ply 2 at v150, v300 and the final against bfp (v300, v450), probit-late (v300, v399) and diversity-p2 (v300, v399); ply 1 at the final; an acceleration ladder (p2c F-P v100/v150/v200 vs probit-late F-P v300); the cycle any line passes any reference (none expected); the per-cycle reference share of the batch (~58-60%). Predictions (6.57; ply 2, head to head, +-28): p2c F-P v150 vs probit-late F-P v300 0-60, v200 20-80; vs bfp at v300 -20..40, at v400 vs bfp v450 -40..20 (ceiling within 30); over diversity-p2's F-P at v300 20-80; p2c tree vs its flat -40..0; ply 1 final vs pure -20..30. Plan rules: p2c F-P 40+ over bfp at v400 = strong foreign play raises the ceiling, the league goes to ply 2 with the window; within 30 = speed only, the ply-2 question becomes compute; 40+ below = strong narrow play starves coverage, and the references must be a mix of strengths above the window (the thunderdome's own composition).
